quote: We asked for demos from people who’d never heard of us.
text: Cold audience, hot ask. Nobody books a call with a logo they’ve never seen.

quote: Our cost per lead looks great. Sales says the leads are junk.
text: The campaigns are chasing cheap clicks, not the accounts you actually want to sell to.

quote: We launched, and then nothing really changed.
text: Same ads for months, no testing, a narrow audience that stopped paying attention long ago.

quote: Leadership asks what LinkedIn brings in. We can’t answer.
text: You’re measuring last-click on a channel that does its work before the click.
